- Reporter - Reporter to use (e.g., "html", "list")
- Grep - Filter tests by pattern
- UpdateSnapshots - Update visual snapshots
- UseNpmScript - Use `npm run` instead of `npx playwright test`
- NpmScriptName - Custom script name when UseNpmScript is true

To run the suite once per database, give each variant an npm script that sets an env var (for example `"test:postgres": "E2E_DB_PROVIDER=postgres playwright test"`) and call `Playwright.Test(dir, o => { o.UseNpmScript = true; o.NpmScriptName = "test:postgres"; })`.

### Git
- Git.Tag(tagName, options?) - Create a git tag (annotated by default)
- Git.Push(options?) - Push the current branch to the remote. Does not push tags (use Git.PushTags).
- Git.PushTags(remote?) - Push tags (not the branch; use Git.Push) to the remote, skipping tags that already exist remotely (default: origin). Tags are pushed individually.

Evaluated when the script loads (on the host, NOT steps; absent from --dry-run, they run before the container exists and do not see changes made by earlier steps):
- Git.Commit - Full SHA of the commit being built (HEAD, or the commit given with `--ref`). Property. Step-based counterpart: Git.RevParse.
- Git.ShortCommit - Short SHA of the commit being built. Property. Step-based counterpart: Git.RevParse(shortSha: true).
- Git.CommitTime - Commit time of the commit being built as a `long` of unix seconds. Property, cached. Example: `o.WithTimestamp(Git.CommitTime)`.
- Git.RequireClean(params string[] paths) - Also evaluated at script load. Throws before any step runs if tracked files are modified, staged or deleted, or non-ignored untracked files exist, under the paths (whole repository if none). Always passes with `--ref`. `.ando/runs/` is ignored, so run records never trip it.
- Git.ChangedSince(sinceRef, params string[] paths) - True if any file under the paths differs between sinceRef and the commit being built (committed changes only). Step-based counterpart: Git.ChangedFiles.
- Git.LastTag(pattern = "*") - Most recent tag reachable from the commit being built that matches the glob (for example `"v*"`), or null. Step-based counterpart: Git.LatestTag.

Git.Commit, ShortCommit, CommitTime, RequireClean, ChangedSince and LastTag run git on the host while the script is evaluated, so their values can be used directly in `if` and string interpolation.

Step variants (these ARE steps: they run on the host in the source root, the --ref worktree when set, in order with the other steps like Git.Tag/Git.Push, and appear in --dry-run). Each returns a CommandStep whose Value is the trimmed stdout; read it at execution time (Ando.When, Ando.Defer, Ando.Report, Func<> overloads), not at the top level of the script:
- Git.RevParse(string rev = "HEAD", bool shortSha = false) - Step "Git.RevParse": `git rev-parse [--short] <rev>`. Example: `var sha = Git.RevParse(shortSha: true);` Eager counterparts: Git.Commit, Git.ShortCommit. Honors the CommandStep methods WithTimeout, WithEnv, Quiet and AllowFailure; do not use InDirectory (it resolves to a container path, but git runs on the host).
- Git.LatestTag(string pattern = "*") - Step "Git.LatestTag": `git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match <pattern> HEAD`. If no tag matches, Value is empty and the build continues (allowed failure). Example: `var t = Git.LatestTag("v*");` Eager counterpart: Git.LastTag. Ignores all the CommandStep fluent methods.
- Git.ChangedFiles(string sinceRef, params string[] paths) - Step "Git.ChangedFiles": `git diff --name-only <sinceRef> HEAD -- <paths>`. Value is a newline-separated list, empty when nothing changed; an unknown ref fails the step. Example: `var c = Git.ChangedFiles(t.Value, "src/Worker"); Ando.When(() => c.Value != "", () => Log.Info("Worker changed"));` Eager counterpart: Git.ChangedSince. Honors the CommandStep methods WithTimeout, WithEnv, Quiet and AllowFailure; do not use InDirectory (it resolves to a container path, but git runs on the host).

### Shell
- Shell.Run(command, params string[] args) - Escape hatch for one-off commands that have no ANDO operation; prefer a first-party operation when one exists. Run a command in the build container. Arguments are passed as a list, with no shell parsing. Fails on non-zero exit unless `AllowFailure()`. Returns a CommandStep.
- Shell.Bash(script) - Run a script with `bash -euo pipefail -c` in the build container (pipes, redirection, sourcing). Returns a CommandStep.

Note: hook scripts have a different `Shell` global (`Shell.RunAsync`). The `Shell.Run` and `Shell.Bash` described here are for build.csando.

### Bun
- Bun.Install(version = "latest", sha256 = null) - Install Bun into /usr/local/bin so later steps (including MSBuild targets run by Dotnet.Publish) find `bun` on PATH. Skips the download if that version is already installed. Installs curl and unzip with apt when missing; needs a Debian or Ubuntu image. With `sha256`, `version` must be exact (not "latest"): the release zip `bun-linux-x64.zip` or `bun-linux-aarch64.zip` (chosen by `uname -m`) is downloaded from GitHub, verified against the hash (the step fails on a mismatch), installed, and `bun --version` must equal the version. The hash is of the zip for the container's architecture; x64 and aarch64 hashes differ. The standard x64 build needs AVX2; on CPUs without AVX2 use the installer path without `sha256` (no hash check). With a hash the step always downloads and verifies. Examples: `Bun.Install("1.2.23");` `Bun.Install("1.2.23", sha256: "<sha256 of bun-linux-x64.zip>");`

### GitHub
- GitHub.CreatePr(options) - Create a pull request (requires gh CLI)
- GitHub.CreateRelease(options) - Create a GitHub release with optional file uploads (use WithFiles() to attach assets, supports path#name syntax)
- GitHub.PushImage(imageName, options?) - **Deprecated**: Use Docker.Build with WithPush() instead for atomic builds.

### Profiles
Profiles allow conditional execution of build steps. `DefineProfile()` returns a `Profile` object — capture it in a variable. It evaluates to `true` when that profile is active:
```csharp
// Capture the Profile in a variable
var release = DefineProfile("release");

Dotnet.Build(app);
Dotnet.Test(tests);

// Profile evaluates to true when activated via -p flag
if (release) {
    Git.Tag("v1.0.0");
    GitHub.CreateRelease(o => o
        .WithTag("v1.0.0")
        .WithGeneratedNotes()
        .WithFiles("dist/app#app-linux", "dist/app.exe#app-windows.exe"));
}
```

Activate with CLI: `ando -p release` or `ando -p publish,release`

## Options Reference

### Dotnet.Restore Options
- WithRuntime(string) - Target runtime identifier (e.g., "linux-x64", "win-x64")
- NoCache - Bypass NuGet cache, force fresh downloads

### Dotnet.Build Options
- Configuration - Debug or Release
- NoRestore - Skip implicit restore
- WithSourceRevision(sha) - Add `-p:SourceRevisionId=<sha>` (overrides the automatic value)
- WithoutSourceRevision() - Suppress the automatic -p:SourceRevisionId (ANDO's value otherwise overrides a project-level <SourceRevisionId>)

### Dotnet.Test Options
- Configuration - Build configuration
- NoRestore - Skip restore
- NoBuild - Skip build (implies NoRestore)
- Filter - Test filter expression (e.g., "Category=Unit", "Name=MyTest")
- WithSourceRevision(sha) - Add `-p:SourceRevisionId=<sha>` (overrides the automatic value)
- WithoutSourceRevision() - Suppress the automatic -p:SourceRevisionId (ANDO's value otherwise overrides a project-level <SourceRevisionId>)

### Dotnet.Publish Options
- Output(path) - Output directory for artifacts
- WithConfiguration(Configuration) - Debug or Release
- WithRuntime(string) - Target runtime (e.g., "linux-x64", "linux-arm64", "win-x64", "osx-arm64")
- AsSelfContained(bool) - Include .NET runtime (default: true when called)
- AsSingleFile(bool) - Bundle into single executable
- SkipRestore() - Skip restore before publishing
- SkipBuild() - Skip build before publishing
- WithNoLogo() - Pass --nologo
- WithSourceRevision(sha) - Add `-p:SourceRevisionId=<sha>`; ANDO adds the full commit being built automatically (nothing outside a git repository) unless you set this or use NoBuild
- WithoutSourceRevision() - Suppress the automatic -p:SourceRevisionId (ANDO's value otherwise overrides a project-level <SourceRevisionId>)

### Nuget.Pack Options
- Output(path) - Output directory for .nupkg
- WithConfiguration(Configuration) - Build configuration
- WithVersion(string) - Explicit package version
- WithVersionSuffix(string) - Pre-release suffix (e.g., "beta", "rc1")
- WithSourceRevision(sha) - Add `-p:SourceRevisionId=<sha>`; ANDO adds the full commit being built automatically (nothing outside a git repository) unless you set this or use SkipBuild
- WithoutSourceRevision() - Suppress the automatic -p:SourceRevisionId (ANDO's value otherwise overrides a project-level <SourceRevisionId>)
- WithSymbols(bool) - Generate .snupkg for debugging
- WithSource(bool) - Include source files in symbols
- SkipRestore() - Skip restore
- SkipBuild() - Skip build

### Nuget.Push Options
- ToSource(string) - NuGet feed URL
- ToNuGetOrg() - Push to nuget.org (default)
- WithApiKey(string) - API key (or use NUGET_API_KEY env var)
- SkipDuplicates(bool) - Skip if version exists (default: true)
- WithoutSymbols(bool) - Don't push .snupkg

### Docker.Build Options
- WithTag(string) - Add image tag (can call multiple times). Use full registry path for push (e.g., "ghcr.io/org/app:v1")
- WithPlatform(string) - Single target platform (e.g., "linux/amd64")
- WithPlatforms(params string[]) - Multiple target platforms for multi-arch builds (e.g., "linux/amd64", "linux/arm64")
- WithContext(string) - Build context directory
- WithBuildArg(key, value) - Pass build argument to Dockerfile
- WithPush() - **Recommended**: Push images to registry atomically during build. Ensures all tags point to same manifest.
- WithNoCache() - Disable build cache
- WithoutLoad() - Disable loading image into local docker (useful when only pushing)

### Git.Tag Options
- WithMessage(string) - Tag message for annotated tags
- AsLightweight() - Create lightweight tag instead of annotated
- WithSkipIfExists() - Skip if tag exists (warn instead of fail)

Note: Annotated tags require a git identity (user.name/user.email). The ANDO CI Server configures this automatically. For CLI builds, the host git config is used.

### Git.Push Options
- ToRemote(string) - Remote name (default: origin)
- ToBranch(string) - Branch to push
- WithUpstream() - Set upstream tracking (-u flag)

### GitHub.CreateRelease Options
- WithTag(string) - Tag name (e.g., "v1.0.0")
- WithTitle(string) - Release title
- WithNotes(string) - Markdown release notes
- WithGeneratedNotes() - Auto-generate notes from commits since last release
- AsDraft() - Create as draft (not visible until published)
- AsPrerelease() - Mark as pre-release
- WithoutPrefix() - Don't add 'v' prefix to tag
- WithFiles(params string[]) - Files to upload as release assets

### GitHub.CreatePr Options
- WithTitle(string) - PR title
- WithBody(string) - PR description (markdown)
- WithBase(string) - Target branch (e.g., "main")
- WithHead(string) - Source branch
- AsDraft() - Create as draft PR

### Bicep.Deploy Options
- WithName(string) - Custom deployment name
- WithParameterFile(string) - Path to .json or .bicepparam file
- WithParameter(name, value) - Inline parameter
- WithMode(DeploymentMode) - Incremental (default) or Complete
- WithDeploymentSlot(string) - App Service slot

### Cloudflare.PagesDeploy Options
- WithProjectName(string) - Pages project name
- WithBranch(string) - Git branch for deployment
- WithCommitHash(string) - Commit hash for tracking
- WithCommitMessage(string) - Commit message for tracking

### AppService.DeployZip Options
- WithDeploymentSlot(string) - Deploy to specific slot
- WithNoWait() - Don't wait for completion
- WithRestart() - Pass `--restart true` to `az webapp deploy` so the app restarts after the deployment
- WithTimeout(TimeSpan) - Max time to wait for zip deploy before reconciling/retrying (default 20 minutes)

AppService.DeployZip is resilient to flaky Azure uploads: if the deploy command times out it reconciles against the latest Kudu deployment status (treating a completed deployment as success), and it retries transient failures (5xx, Service Unavailable, connection resets) with backoff up to 3 attempts within the WithTimeout budget.

### Functions.DeployZip Options
- WithDeploymentSlot(string) - Deploy to specific slot (--slot)
- WithOneDeploy() - Use OneDeploy (`az functionapp deploy --type zip`, preview) instead of the default config-zip
- WithNoWait() - OneDeploy only (throws without WithOneDeploy): --async true
- WithRestart() - OneDeploy only (throws without WithOneDeploy): --restart true; default --restart false
- WithTimeout(TimeSpan) - Maximum wait before retrying; passed to az as --timeout (seconds for config-zip, milliseconds for OneDeploy; default 20 minutes). Works on both paths

### Functions.Publish Options
- WithDeploymentSlot(string) - Publish to specific slot
- WithConfiguration(string) - Build configuration
- WithForceRestart() - Force restart after publishing
- WithNoWait() - Don't wait for completion

### Ando.Build Options
- WithVerbosity(string) - Output verbosity (Quiet, Minimal, Normal, Detailed)
- ColdStart(bool) - Force fresh container
- WithDind(bool) - Enable Docker-in-Docker
- WithImage(string) - Override Docker image
- WithProfile(string) - Activate profiles for child build (e.g., "publish" or "test,release")

## Tips for Writing Build Scripts

1. Build scripts are C# - use C# syntax including var, lambdas, string interpolation
2. No semicolons needed at end of lines (but they work if included)
3. Operations execute in the order they are called, but only after the whole script was evaluated (see "Step model and deployment gates" for blocks, cleanup and conditions)
4. Use Dotnet.Project() for .csproj files, Directory() for folders
5. The `/` operator concatenates paths: Root / "src" / "app"
6. Options are configured via fluent lambdas: o => o.Output(...).WithRuntime(...)
7. Call EnsureAuthenticated() early when you want to validate cloud credentials; Cloudflare.PagesDeploy() also verifies Pages project access automatically
8. Use `ando verify` to check scripts without executing

## Common Mistakes

| Mistake | Error | Fix |
|---------|-------|-----|
| `Ando.Env("NAME")` | CS1061: 'AndoOperations' does not contain 'Env' | Use `Env("NAME")` — it's a global function |
| `Env("NAME", "default")` | CS1503: cannot convert from 'string' to 'bool' | Use `Env("NAME", required: false) ?? "default"` |
| `DefineProfile("name", "desc")` | CS1501: No overload takes 2 arguments | Use `DefineProfile("name")` — single argument only |
| `HasProfile("name")` | CS0103: 'HasProfile' does not exist | Use `var p = DefineProfile("name"); if (p) { ... }` |
| `Ando.SetEnv("NAME", "value")` | CS1061: 'AndoOperations' does not contain 'SetEnv' | Set env vars via `.env.ando` files or OS environment |
| `Npm.Ci(Root)` | CS1503: cannot convert 'BuildPath' to 'DirectoryRef' | Use `Npm.Ci(Directory("."))` |
| `Profile("name")` | CS0119: 'Profile' is a type | Use `DefineProfile("name")` to create profiles |
| `try { AppService.SwapSlots(...); } finally { AppService.Stop(...); }` | No error; the `finally` code runs while the script is evaluated, not after the steps | Use `Ando.Block(...).Finally(...)` or `Ando.Finally(...)` |
| `Git.GetVersion()`, `Git.BumpVersion()`, `Git.CommitCount()`, `Git.ShortSha()` | CS1061: 'GitOperations' does not contain a definition | Use `Git.LastTag("v*")`, `Git.ShortCommit`, `Git.RevParse(...)`; bump versions with `ando bump` |
| `Dotnet.Pack(...)` | CS1061: 'DotnetOperations' does not contain 'Pack' | Use `Nuget.Pack(project, o => o.WithVersion(...))` |
| `Dotnet.Build(project, o => o.WithProperty("Version", v))` | CS1061: 'DotnetBuildOptions' does not contain 'WithProperty' | Set MSBuild properties in the project file or `Directory.Build.props`; `Nuget.Pack` has `WithVersion` |
| `Docker.Push(...)`, `Docker.Tag(...)`, `Docker.Build(dir, "tag")`, `Docker.ComposeUp()` | CS1061 / CS1501 | Use `Docker.Build("Dockerfile", o => o.WithTag("...").WithPush())`; run `docker compose` with `Shell.Run("docker", "compose", ...)` |
| `Cloudflare.WorkersDeploy(...)` | CS1061: 'CloudflareOperations' does not contain 'WorkersDeploy' | Run Wrangler through an npm script: `Npm.Run(dir, "deploy")` |
| `if (show.Value == "x") { ... }` at the top level | InvalidOperationException: output not available yet | Read outputs inside `Ando.When(() => ..., ...)` or `Ando.Defer(() => ...)` |
